notes: 2.8.3 The other methods adopted by the suicide victims include causing sudden physical harm, inflicting myuries to
the body through other means etc. Significant proportion of suicide victims took to other means such as drowning
(9.2%), fire/self immolation (10.7%), inflicting injury on self (0.6%). Jumping from buildings (0.5%), jumping
from other sites (0.8%), jumping off from moving trains/vehicles (0.7%). coming under the moving vehicles/trains
(2.8%) were the other means by which some suicide victims brought end to their lives. The above mentioned 7
means accounted for 25.3 per cent of the total suicide victims in 1997. For further details such as age and sex-wise
profile in the means adopted by the victims-Table-21 can be referred.
